title: Guest is redirected away from protected routes
description: A guest cannot access protected app areas directly and is redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /perfil
Verify the login page is displayed
Navigate to /usuarios
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Admin views the user list from the initial route
description: An admin signs in and is taken to the user management area with the user table visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user list page is displayed
Verify the user table is visible

title: Guest cannot access the users list
description: This verifies that a guest trying to open the protected users list is redirected to sign in.

steps.description: Navigate to /usuarios
Verify the user is redirected to the login page

title: Guest signs up and lands in own profile
description: A new guest can register successfully and is automatically signed in to their profile with the user role shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /registro
Fill in the name field with a new user name
Fill in the email field with a unique email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with the same valid password
Submit the registration form
Verify the profile page is displayed
Verify the user role is shown as a regular user

title: User logs in and reaches the role-based area
description: An authenticated user can sign in and is redirected to the area appropriate for their role.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the authenticated area is displayed
Verify the user lands on the area for their role

title: Regular user is redirected away from the admin users list
description: This verifies that a signed-in non-admin user cannot access the admin users list and is sent to their profile area instead.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the users list link or navigate to the users area from the app
Verify the user is redirected to the profile area

title: Authenticated user logs out
description: A signed-in user can log out and is returned to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the profile page
Log out
Verify the login page is displayed
Verify the user is no longer signed in

title: Admin can view and browse the users list
description: This verifies that an admin can open the users list, see results, and move through paginated pages.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the users list is displayed
Click the next page control
Verify a different page of users is displayed

title: Unknown routes show the not found page
description: An invalid route displays the application not found screen instead of a protected view or blank page.

steps.description: Navigate to a non-existent route
Verify the not found page is displayed
Verify the page shows a page not found state

title: Admin searches users by name or email
description: An admin can filter the user table by search terms and see matching results in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the user list page
Enter a search term for a known user name or email
Verify the user list shows matching results
Verify the filtered table is displayed

title: Authenticated user updates profile details
description: A signed-in user can change their name and email and see the updated profile information afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the profile page
Update the name field with a new value
Update the email field with a new value
Save the profile changes
Verify the profile page shows the updated user details
Verify the saved profile information is visible

title: Admin can search users by name or email
description: This verifies that an admin can narrow the users list using the search field and see matching results.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Fill the users search field with a valid name or email fragment
Verify the users list is filtered to matching results

title: Admin filters users by role
description: An admin can switch the role filter and see the list update to users with that role.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the user list page
Select a role filter value
Verify the user list is filtered by role
Verify the filtered results are visible

title: Authenticated user changes password successfully
description: A signed-in user can submit the current password and a new password and see password change confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the profile page
Fill in the current password field with the current password
Fill in the new password field with a new valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with the same new valid password
Submit the password change form
Verify a password change confirmation is visible
Verify the profile page remains displayed

title: Admin can filter users by role
description: This verifies that an admin can filter the users list by role and see only users in the selected role.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Select a role filter value
Verify the users list shows only users for the selected role

title: Admin can delete a user after confirming the dialog
description: This verifies that an admin can confirm logical deletion and the user is removed from the active list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the delete action for a user already shown in the list
Confirm the deletion
Verify the deleted user no longer appears in the active list

title: Admin paginates through the user list
description: An admin can move to another page of the user table and see a different set of users.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the user list page
Go to the next page of results
Verify a different page of users is displayed
Verify the pagination state has changed

title: Admin can edit an existing user and see updated data
description: This verifies that an admin can open a user for editing, save changes, and see the updated row in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the edit action for a user already shown in the list
Update the name field with a new unique value
Update the email field with a new unique value
Submit the user form
Verify the updated user is shown in the list

title: Admin edits an existing user and sees the updated row
description: An admin can open an existing user, save changes, and see the updated information reflected in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the user list page
Open an existing user for editing
Update the user details
Save the user changes
Verify the updated user row is visible in the list
Verify the edit changes are reflected

title: Admin can create a new user and see it in the list
description: This verifies that an admin can create a new user from the form and then find the new user in the users list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the new user action
Fill in the name field with a unique user name
Fill in the email field with a unique email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the user form
Verify the newly created user appears in the users list

title: Admin creates a user and then removes them logically
description: An admin can create a new user, confirm it appears in the list, and then perform a logical delete with confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the user list page
Start creating a new user
Fill in the new user's details
Save the new user
Verify the new user appears in the list
Start the logical delete for the new user
Confirm the delete action
Verify the user is removed or marked inactive in the list
Verify the delete confirmation flow completed

title: Admin can cancel user deletion
description: This verifies that cancelling the delete confirmation keeps the user in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the delete action for a user already shown in the list
Cancel the deletion
Verify the user remains in the active list

title: Guest sees invalid credentials feedback on login
description: A guest entering wrong login credentials sees an invalid credentials alert and stays on the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with an invalid email address
Fill in the password field with an invalid password
Submit the login form
Verify an invalid credentials alert is visible
Verify the login page remains displayed

title: Guest sees validation when password is too weak
description: A guest cannot complete registration with a weak password and sees validation feedback instead of entering the app.

steps.description: Navigate to /registro
Fill in the name field with a new user name
Fill in the email field with a unique email address
Fill in the password field with a weak password
Fill in the password confirmation field with the same weak password
Submit the registration form
Verify a password validation error is visible
Verify the registration page remains displayed

title: Guest sees validation when password confirmation does not match
description: A guest cannot complete registration when the password confirmation differs and sees validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /registro
Fill in the name field with a new user name
Fill in the email field with a unique email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with a different valid password
Submit the registration form
Verify a confirmation mismatch validation error is visible
Verify the registration page remains displayed
